ModMetaData.name: Odyssey Shuttle Variants
ModMetaData.author: Luke
ModMetaData.description:
Expands RimWorld's Odyssey transport-shuttle system with a family of buildable, role-distinct craft and a typed-capacity system that tracks colonists, mechs and cargo as independent pools instead of one shared mass limit.
THE CRAFT - Passenger Shuttle (vanilla, folded into the system) - the balanced all-rounder: a handful of seats and modest cargo. - Troop Shuttle - fast squad insertion and extraction: many seats, light cargo, long range. - Cargo Shuttle - dedicated hauler: a large hold with just enough crew to fly it. - Heavy Cargo Ship - the flagship hauler: the biggest hold in the fleet, but slow, fuel-hungry and short-ranged. - Mechanitor Shuttle (Biotech) - a mech strike carrier flown by a mechanitor; it will not launch without one aboard. It ferries a mech warband against a bandwidth budget rather than a seat count. When landed it also doubles as a chemfuel-powered field charger: nearby colony mechs walk up to the hull and recharge from the shuttle's own fuel, no power grid required (an opt-in toggle, off by default so it never strands itself). - Transport Drone (Biotech) - a fully autonomous courier with no crew. Send it anywhere, land and hold its cargo in the field, then recall it, send it onward, form a camp, or gift its cargo to a friendly settlement for goodwill.
FEATURES - Typed capacity: colonists (seats), mechs (bandwidth budget) and cargo (mass, excluding crew and mech weight) are capped independently, with clear load-dialog readouts and over-cap warnings. - Autonomous drone: hands-free supply runs and automated diplomacy gifts; it survives the origin map being abandoned. - Mech field charging at a landed Mechanitor Shuttle, run off its own chemfuel. - Mech-bay expansion research: two tiers that raise the Mechanitor Shuttle's carried-mech bandwidth (6 to 12 to 18) and widen its field-charging line (2 to 3 to 4 mechs at once). Already-built ships benefit the moment the research completes. - Every craft is research-gated off the vanilla Shuttles project, built in the Odyssey architect category, and costs a rare shuttle engine (trader/reward only; larger craft need more).
COMPATIBILITY - Instant Loot Shuttle: supported. Crew no longer count against the cargo hold when instant-loading, so a full squad will not refuse the launch or leave your cargo behind. - Shuttle retextures: safe. Each craft here is its own def with its own art, and the only vanilla thing this mod changes on the passenger shuttle is its capacity - no graphics are touched.
MULTIPLAYER Built with the Multiplayer mod and played through multiplayer sessions without trouble. One player has reported mass and landing problems that only appear in multiplayer, which I have not yet been able to reproduce - if you run into anything like that, please say so in the comments, it genuinely helps. It also runs fine without Multiplayer installed. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2606448745
COMPANION MODS Two mods that handle the other half of the same job - getting one of these craft loaded and away without ten minutes of clicking:
Crew Presets - save named groups of colonists, animals and mechs - "Strike Team", "Pack Train" - and apply them with one click in the load dialog, instead of hand-picking the same pawns every launch. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3756372833
Transporter Loadouts - every transporter and shuttle remembers its own default cargo, pre-filled each time you open its load dialog. Crew Presets picks the people; this one picks the freight. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3756377821
Requires Odyssey. The Mechanitor Shuttle and Transport Drone additionally require Biotech.
CHANGES 1.0.1 - Fixed crew being charged against cargo capacity when loading with Instant Loot Shuttle, which could refuse a launch outright or load the crew and leave the cargo behind. - A craft arriving somewhere with no room large enough to land now holds position with its cargo aboard, to be recalled or redirected, instead of being set down where it does not fit.
